entities.summary: Mark O'Connell is a Canadian-born American Catholic prelate who was appointed Bishop of Albany in October 2025, and was installed on December 5, 2025. He had served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Boston. He was the vicar general and moderator of the curia for the archdiocese from 2023 to 2025.
